newsitem.title: USA: HEALTHSOUTH and Health Images to merge.
newsitem.headline: HEALTHSOUTH and Health Images to merge.

text.p: Healthsouth Corp and Health Images Inc said Monday they signed a definitive agreement under which Healthsouth will acquire Health Images.

Valued at about $270 million, the transaction will add 55 imaging centers, including six facilities in the United Kingdom, to Healthsouth's existing network of over 1,000 locations in 50 states, a statement issued by the companies said.

Healthsouth is the nation's largest provider of outpatient surgery and rehabilitative healthcare services and Health Images is one of the largest providers of diagnostic imaging services in the United States, the statement said.
HEALTHSOUTH said it expects the transaction to be immediately accretive to earnings.

Under the terms of the agreement, which has been approved by the boards of both companies, Health Images stockholders will receive 0.446 of a share of HEALTHSOUTH common stock per Health Images share, the statement said.
There is no provision for either company to terminate the agreement based upon fluctuations in HEALTHSOUTH's stock price, the statement said.

The agreement provides for the payment of a $10 million break-up fee in the event that Health Images terminates the transaction under certain circumstances and is the subject of an acquisition transaction within one year thereafter.
